name: cumcm-thesis
title_zh: 摘要先过审稿人三问，再谈建模的国赛论文打磨器
tagline_zh: 建模论文最怕摘要像综述、公式像贴图、结论像自嗨。它按国赛评阅标准逐段体检，连 LaTeX 排版裂缝都给你指出来。
tagline_en: Terrified your CUMCM paper reads like a survey, formulas like stickers, conclusions like self-praise? It audits.
desc_en: Use when writing, revising, structuring, checking, or polishing a CUMCM or similar mathematical modeling paper, including abstracts, mathematical exposition, results, model evaluation, LaTeX, or final review.
why_zh: 它不泛泛说'加强逻辑'，而是把摘要拆成'问题重述-模型亮点-结果可信度'三问逐句审。
why_en: No vague 'improve logic' advice. It splits the abstract into three reviewer questions, checks symbol consistency across.
limit_zh: 只认 CUMCM/数模国赛及同规格论文的写作规范；不负责建模思路创新、算法选型、数据清洗。若你的论文还在草稿阶段。
limit_en: Only for CUMCM-style papers with complete results. No modeling innovation, algorithm selection, or data cleaning. Draft-stage papers get structure.
title_en: CUMCM paper polisher: abstract passes 3 reviewer tests first
